title: Warm Smoky Polish Chicken Skillet
description: A smoky and crispy Polish dish featuring tabasco sauce, double-fry chicken, and anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients, cooked to perfection in a claypot.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a claypot over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the claypot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the claypot and set aside.
Add the diced potatoes to the claypot and cook until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper to the claypot and stir to combine.
Add the tabasco sauce to the claypot and stir to combine.
Add the chicken back to the claypot and stir to combine with the potatoes and spices.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, until the chicken is cooked through and the potatoes are tender, about 20 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
